references.text: The same list of the seven nations that God will drive out before Israel: the Canaanites, Hittites, Hivites, Perizzites, Girgashites, Amorites, and Jebusites.
God promises to lead Israel to a land where Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites live.
God's angel will go before Israel and drive out the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
Command to strike these nations with the ban: the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
The expression 'the living God' (אֵל חַי) is also used here as a description of the true God.
Peter confesses Jesus as 'the Son of the living God', which connects to the expression 'the living God' in Joshua.
The Lord will go before Israel like a consuming fire and drive out and destroy the same nations.
Command to drive out all the inhabitants of Canaan when Israel crosses the Jordan.
Paul refers to 'the living and true God', continuing the Old Testament expression 'the living God'.
